summary: Take the user's chosen option (and any parameter changes) forward -> selected.json + output/selected_plan.svg + output/planner_settings.json.
inputs: work/selection.json — a 'Save settings' file from the planner app, or {"option": "A", "params": {...}, "accepted": [...]}
outputs: layer manifest ("layers": files + sha256, supplied / survived keys)
checks: plot dimensions in the selection match site.json
no failing QC finding unless listed in selection.accepted with a reason (logged)
manual: The user picks the option (in the planner or in chat). The approval text for this task must name the option.
title: User's chosen option -> selected.json
